live.title: Live
live.lead: Run a test now or watch a scheduled one as it happens.
live.reconnecting: Live view lost its connection and is reconnecting.
live.noResultYet: No test yet. Start one on the left or add a schedule.
live.belowPlan: This test was below the threshold of your plan.

history.title: History
history.emptyText: Pick a longer range or start a test on the Live page.
history.deleteText: The test from {{when}} will be removed from the history and the averages.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.lead: When and how often nexpulse measures on its own.
schedule.noOverlap: Tests never overlap. If one is still running, the next one waits up to 30 minutes, then skips its slot.
schedule.emptyText: Without a schedule, nexpulse only measures when you start a test.
schedule.name: Name
schedule.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. Example: 0 */3 * * 1-5
schedule.windowHint: The same time twice means all day.
schedule.offsetHint: Start up to five minutes early or late, so not everyone hits the server on the hour.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Sources, access, your plan and alerts.

sources.favoritesHint: A schedule can go through your favorites in turn. The Live page always offers all servers.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.text: Works right away, no setup. Cloudflare picks its nearest data center on its own, so you cannot choose a server. Measures latency under load too, but not packet loss. Cloudflare refuses tests that come too often; one an hour is plenty.

librespeed.name: LibreSpeed
librespeed.text: Open source. Use the public servers or your own, for example to test the path between two sites. Automatic tries the nearest servers briefly and takes the fastest.
librespeed.publicHint: The list from librespeed.org, mostly in Europe and North America.
librespeed.ownNone: None yet. Any LibreSpeed server works, for example the linuxserver/librespeed container.
librespeed.urlRequired: Enter the address of the server.

ookla.name: Ookla Speedtest
ookla.text: Thousands of servers, pick the one next door. Also measures packet loss. nexpulse does not include Ookla's software: it downloads the Speedtest CLI from Ookla once you activate it.
ookla.activateText: nexpulse will download the official Speedtest CLI from Ookla into your data folder.
ookla.warningTitle: Ookla's license does not cover this use
ookla.warningText: Ookla allows the CLI only for personal, non-commercial use on a single personal computer. It forbids running it on a device other devices can reach over the network, and on routers, modems or other devices that are not personal computers. A container in your homelab falls under that. If you activate it anyway, you do so at your own risk.
ookla.dataNote: Ookla receives your IP address and the results of every test.
ookla.accept: I have read Ookla's license, terms and privacy policy. I understand that they do not cover this use, and I take responsibility for it.
ookla.removeText: nexpulse deletes the Speedtest CLI and your acceptance. Past Ookla results stay in the history. Schedules using Ookla are skipped until you activate it again.

access.passwordIntro: Off by default. Turn it on if nexpulse can be reached from outside your network.
access.passwordSet: Password saved. Other browsers have to sign in again.
access.forgotten: Forgot it? This turns the password off:
access.keysIntro: For nexdeck, Home Assistant and other dashboards. The API always needs a key, even with the password off.

scopeHint.read: Latest result, history and averages. Enough for a dashboard.
scopeHint.run: Can also start tests, for example from an automation.

access.keyOnce: Copy it now. nexpulse only keeps a hash and cannot show it again.
access.keyNexdeck: In nexdeck, add the nexpulse widget and enter the address of nexpulse and this key.
access.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the key and copy it by hand.
access.revokeText: Everything that uses "{{name}}" loses access immediately.
access.headerHint: Send the key as X-Api-Key or as Authorization: Bearer. Full reference:

plan.title: Your plan
plan.intro: What your provider promises. Used for the plan line in the history and for slow-test alerts.
plan.alertsIntro: When nexpulse should tell you. Only works with a notification target below.
plan.alertFailed: Test failed, for example no connection
plan.keepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved address.
plan.urlInvalid: The address has to start with http:// or https://.

data.resultsIntro: How long nexpulse keeps results, and the time zone for schedules.
data.timezoneHint: Schedules run at this wall clock time. Without a choice, nexpulse uses {{zone}} from the container.
data.updatesIntro: nexpulse can ask GitHub once a day whether there is a newer version.
data.updateCheckHint: Sends nothing but the request itself. No results, no settings.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Speed test tracker for your homelab. Part of the nex apps.
about.upToDate: You are up to date. Checked {{when}}.
about.providersIntro: nexpulse measures against these services. Each has its own terms and sees your IP address during a test.

provider.cloudflare: Anycast speed test on Cloudflare's network. The same endpoints as speed.cloudflare.com.
provider.librespeed: Open source speed test. Public servers run by volunteers and hosters, or your own.
provider.ookla: Speedtest by Ookla. Only after you activate it, at your own risk: its license does not cover this use.

about.trademarks: Cloudflare, LibreSpeed, Ookla and Speedtest are names of their owners. nexpulse is not affiliated with them.

errors.network: nexpulse cannot be reached. Is it running?
errors.http: The server answered with an error (HTTP {{status}}).
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Reference: {{id}}
errors.tooManyAttemptsSeconds_one: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.tooManyAttemptsSeconds_other: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.tooManyAttemptsMinutes_one: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} minute.
errors.tooManyAttemptsMinutes_other: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in {{count}} minutes.

byCode.missing_header: This request was blocked because it did not come from the nexpulse interface.
byCode.not_signed_in: You are signed out. Sign in again.
byCode.invalid_api_key: The API key is missing or unknown.
byCode.key_read_only: This API key may only read.
byCode.invalid_input: Some of the input is not valid.
byCode.busy: A test is already running. Wait until it finishes.
byCode.invalid_cron: This cron expression is not valid.
byCode.last_source: At least one source has to stay on.
byCode.invalid_url: This is not a valid address.
byCode.server_exists: This server is already in the list.
byCode.librespeed_not_found: No LibreSpeed server answered at this address.
byCode.notify_unreachable: The notification target could not be reached.
byCode.notify_rejected: The notification target refused the message. Check the address and token.
byCode.unreachable: The test server could not be reached.
byCode.server_error: The test server answered with an error.
byCode.no_server: No server answered. Check the source settings.
byCode.unstable: The connection to the test server kept breaking off, so there is no reliable result.
byCode.server_gone: The chosen server is no longer in the list.
byCode.interrupted: nexpulse was restarted during this test.
byCode.unexpected: The test failed unexpectedly. The log has the details.
byCode.ookla_unsupported: The Ookla CLI does not run on this system. It needs Linux on x86_64, arm64 or armhf.
byCode.ookla_download_failed: The Ookla CLI could not be downloaded.
byCode.ookla_timeout: The Ookla test took too long and was stopped.
byCode.ookla_failed: The Ookla CLI reported an error. The log has the details.
